statistical_review.simpson: Report both domains separately. Mass-only and gap-deletion effects vary by domain/configuration.
statistical_review.ecological: Aggregate gains and mean weights do not imply benefit for every user.
statistical_review.berkson: Repeated fixed development512 pools; no population extrapolation.
statistical_review.collider: Hit-conditioned decomposition is descriptive only, not causal subgroup evidence.
statistical_review.base_rate: All512 denominators and gained/lost/retained users retained.
statistical_review.regression_to_mean: Base7 exactly reproduced; no extreme-user subgroup selected.
statistical_review.survivorship: All four prescribed arms and both complete512 cohorts included.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: 17 paired comparisons/domain with N10/H10 intervals plus one interaction N10 interval/domain; all uncorrected descriptive.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Repeated development searches and post-result method preference disclosed; not confirmatory.
statistical_review.causation: Mass replacement changes weighting and history scope together. Gap deletion changes dimension; optimization and selected epochs also change.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: Only visible historical items and frozen expert scores enter gate; target labels used for fitting/evaluation, not feature extraction.
